_template_notes.purpose: Per-lane execution status. Phase 4 lane agent updates atomically khi state changes. Orchestrator monitor file để detect timeout/failure. Tham chiếu 03-phase-routing.md Phase 4.
populate: status flow: PENDING → RUNNING → COMPLETED | FAILED | TIMEOUT | SKIPPED
completed_at: ISO 8601 khi agent done (mọi state cuối)
agent_pid: PID của agent process (để force kill nếu timeout)
skip_reason: populate khi SKIPPED (vd 'profile=quick, CD8 not active')
